Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers to the most common questions about selling to TurnedKey.

How much will you pay for my house?

We provide fair market offers based on your home's condition, location, and recent comparable sales. Our offers are competitive and transparent - no hidden deductions or surprise fees at closing.

Are there any fees or commissions?

Absolutely not. Unlike selling with an agent (6% commission), we don't charge any fees, commissions, or closing costs. The offer we give you is the amount you'll receive at closing.

How fast can you close?

We can close in as little as 7 days if you need to sell quickly. However, we're also flexible - if you need 30, 60, or even 90 days, we can accommodate your timeline.

Do I need to make repairs?

No! We buy houses in as-is condition. Whether your property needs minor cosmetic work or major structural repairs, we'll buy it exactly as it is today.

What if I still owe on my mortgage?

Not a problem. We buy homes with existing mortgages all the time. We'll pay off your mortgage at closing and you'll receive the remaining equity.

Is this a legitimate offer or a scam?

We're verified real estate buyers who have purchased 92 homes. We close through licensed title companies and attorneys, ensuring everything is legal and transparent.

Do you buy houses in all 50 states?

Yes! We buy houses nationwide. No matter where your property is located, we can make you a fair cash offer.

What happens after I submit my information?

Within 24 hours, we'll contact you to discuss your property and situation. If it's a good fit, we'll schedule a quick walk-through (or virtual tour) and present you with a no-obligation cash offer within 24 hours.
